title: [v4.6-dev3] Type validation failing with PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create() with exclude array
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot v4.6.dev3
- Not reproducible in: Godot v.4.5.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev3 - macOS Tahoe (26.1.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Pro - Apple M4 Pro (14 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

In v4.6-dev3, this line of code now prints an error at `PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create` every time it runs:

```gdscript
static func can_see_object(
		from: Node3D,
		collider: CollisionObject3D,
		point: Vector3,
		normal: Vector3,
		height: float = 1.5,
		collision_mask: int = 0b101,
) -> bool:
	var space_state: PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D = from.get_world_3d().direct_space_state

	# move this up a bit since it's on the ground at y = 0
	var origin := from.global_transform.origin + Vector3(0, height, 0)

	# move the point a bit forward towards the collider since we want the end to be INSIDE of it
	var end := point + -normal * 0.25

	# the final param here is to exclude the object itself from the raycast
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(origin, end, collision_mask, [from])

	var result := space_state.intersect_ray(query)

	if not result.has("collider"):
		return false

	return result["collider"] == collider
```

The error is:

```
E 0:02:27:327   physics_utils.gd:28 @ can_see_object(): Attempted to set a variable of type 'Object' into a TypedArray of type 'RID'.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed. Returning: false
  <C++ Source>  core/variant/container_type_validate.h:71 @ _internal_validate()
  <Stack Trace> physics_utils.gd:28 @ can_see_object()
```

Followed immediately by:

```
E 0:02:27:327   physics_utils.gd:28 @ can_see_object(): Condition "!_p->typed.validate(value, "set")" is true.
  <C++ Source>  core/variant/array.cpp:520 @ set()
  <Stack Trace> physics_utils.gd:28 @ can_see_object()
```

Looking at the docs, I can see that `PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create` does indeed expect an `Array[RID]`:
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_physicsrayqueryparameters3d.html#class-physicsrayqueryparameters3d-method-create

But as far as I know, you're never really supposed to interact with RIDs from GDScript directly? Passing in the plain object _should_ work here, right? Maybe this is a documentation issue and I'm using it wrong 😅 

### Steps to reproduce

Call `PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create` and pass in a `Node3D` inside of the `exclude` array

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Can make one if needed
